notes: The release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml, "Build and Test") runs `make prepublish`, which is Makefile.source.mjs's prepublish target: set-module-type commonjs, the build of all packages with IS_PUBLISH, the tests, set-module-type clean. These are its commands without the tests. It publishes with Yarn (release-tool), so Yarn packs here too; Yarn is the release the repository commits (.yarn/releases, named by yarnPath). Node: up to 7.28.4 the workflow sets no Node version and takes the one of the GitHub runner; Node 20 gives the published files. Tried on 7.22.5, 7.24.1, 7.25.9, 7.26.0, 7.27.1, 7.28.0 and 7.28.4: every package identical. 7.8.3 does not build this way (no scripts/set-module-type.js, other layout); nothing between 7.8.3 and 7.22.5 was tried, hence min. From 7.28.5 see babel-node25.
